name: Minecraft Servers
description: Nano Studio Craft's servers: create Paper, Purpur, Vanilla, Fabric, Forge or NeoForge servers of any version, or a Velocity proxy (with the Java they need), run them with a server console, share them with friends, send players a resource pack when they join, give players a client pack of a modded server's mods, and install modpacks, mods, plugins and resource packs from Modrinth through the Market.
